title: Simon 7.1.2, first claim: a minimizing current in N ∩ U has varifold stationary in N ∩ U
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, N an embedded C² d-dimensional submanifold with (N̄ ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in N ∩ U (Simon 7.1.1, integer multiplicity competitors) with ∂T = 0 in U (vacuous for n = 0), and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity representation of T with H^n(M ∖ N) = 0. Then v(M, θ) is stationary in N ∩ U: ∫_M θ div_M X dH^n = 0 for every X ∈ C¹_c(U; ℝ^P) with X(x) ∈ T_xN for all x ∈ N ∩ U (R.IsStationaryAlong N).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n d : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (N ∩ U) → BoundaryVanishes T → R.Represents T → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ N) = 0 → R.IsStationaryAlong N
